text:
How shall I name you

when I think of you

and you are not here:


my wild strawberry

my candied lizard

my comfort cone

my silk spinner

cuckoo of my cares

my Aurelia

my gravel flower

my dream creature

my morning hand

my great forgetter

cruiser of my window

my moon concealer

my silver crook

my evening dusk

my solar thread

my snub-nosed hare

my deer head

my hare's paw

my stair frog

my garland of lights

my spring thief

my trembling nag

my silver snail

my inkwell

my brush-tailed fox

my woodcutter

my stormy fugitive

my bear keeper

my tooth-bearer

my horse's ear

my tree in the Prater

my spiral horn

my monkey carrier

my end of winter

my artichoke

my midnight

my countdown


(From the top!)

translation.title: How Shall I Name You?
